name.en: Araucaria mirabilis-inspired attached cone organ specimen
name.zh: 受 Araucaria mirabilis 启发的短枝附生球果器官标本

description.en: Build one branch with a rounded tessellated cone, using preserved scale relief; do not append an imagined whole tree.
description.zh: 制作带圆形镶嵌球果的单枝，依据保存鳞片浮雕，不添加想象整树。

sources.title: Araucaria mirabilis fossil with attached cones
sources.supports: Jurassic cone-bearing Araucaria mirabilis branch specimen.
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original rounded teaching geometry of the preserved organ, not a scan or measured replica. Nominal scale, scale count, muted fossil colors and short-branch curvature are artistic simplifications. Museum text supports attached-cone scope; no source photograph copied.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 保存器官的原创圆厚教学几何，非扫描或实测复制品。名义尺度、鳞片数量、化石配色及短枝弯曲为美术简化。博物馆文字支持附枝球果范围，未复制来源照片。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
